definitions.scope: retrospective CPU arithmetic on authenticated saved reports only
definitions.pair: one withheld complete action versus logged complete action at identical state/time, followed by the same frozen policy
definitions.g: Qpi_withheld - Qpi_logged; evaluator-only true advantage within this finite candidate pair
definitions.e: m-g; relative Q-ranking error; cancels a common Q offset
definitions.p: actual kappa * du; adjusted margin m-p
definitions.head: h=Q1-min(Q1,Q2), dh=h_withheld-h_logged; min-Q margin=m-dh
definitions.head_identity: Q1 relative error = min-Q relative error + dh; arithmetic identity, not proof that one head causes error
definitions.signs: harmful g<-tau; useful g>tau; abs(g)<=tau near/equal and excluded from binary discrimination
definitions.wrong_preference: harmful and m>0, or useful and m<=0; pair tie chooses logged slot0

signal_orientation.delta_u: du: larger extra width predicts harm
signal_orientation.cutoff_distance: max(abs(a0)-knee,0): deeper action gap predicts harm
signal_orientation.head_excess_contrast: dh: greater Q1 excess over twin-min predicts harm

definitions.discrimination: pooled across all eligible pairs; within-bank unweighted mean AUROC among mixed-label banks; between-bank Spearman of mean signal versus harmful fraction, no fitted model
definitions.sensitivity: exact labels plus observed maximum t0 identity discrepancy and twice that discrepancy; empirical numerical stress scales, not a validated error bound or changed original threshold
definitions.dependence: 192 shared banks and 3 pairs per bank per model; 3 independent training seeds; no iid-pair confidence interval
definitions.comparability: same candidate inputs within world; own-policy continuations differ across models and actual states differ across worlds
prohibited_claims: no signed residual or local residual supervision reconstructed

saved_component_inventory.warning: Additional quantities in training receipts do not automatically provide same-state candidate-aligned supervision.
